settings.title: User settings
export.hint: Downloads days.csv with your own days (not days shared with you) and their attachments.
import.title: Import / export
import.hint: Imported days are merged: days with the same title, date and collection are skipped, and missing collections and tags are created. A bare days.csv imports days without attachments.
import.bare_csv: This is a bare days.csv, so attachments and backgrounds are ignored.
import.quota_days: Importing is not possible: you have %d days, this would add %d, and your limit is %d.
import.quota_bytes: Importing is not possible: you use %s, this would add %s, and your storage limit is %s.
import.nothing: There is nothing new to import.
import.done: Import finished: %d days imported, %d duplicates skipped, %d rows with errors.
import.error.field_count: The row has the wrong number of columns.
import.error.archived: “archived” must be empty, true/false, or a date-time such as 2026-01-02T15:04:05Z.
import.error.collection_name: The collection name is invalid (at most 100 characters).
import.error.tag_name: A tag name is invalid (at most 100 characters).
import.error.attachment_missing: A referenced attachment is missing from the archive.
import.error.card_limit: The day's attachments exceed the per-day size limit.
import.error.row: The row could not be imported.
import.error.invalid: The file is not a valid PandaDays export (.zip) or days.csv.
import.error.unsafe: The archive was rejected because it contains unsafe paths or links.
import.error.entries: The archive contains too many files.
import.error.too_large: The file is too large for your remaining storage allowance.
import.error.missing_csv: The archive does not contain days.csv.
import.error.csv: days.csv is malformed or lacks the title and date columns.
import.error.expired: This import has expired. Please upload the file again.
import.error.quota: The import would exceed your day or storage quota.
admin.delete_confirm: I confirm permanent deletion of this user, all their days, and media.
admin.password_hint: Save and securely give this password to the user. They must change it at login. All previous sessions have been revoked.
admin.quota_hint: Leave blank to inherit the site default. Zero blocks new days or uploads. Existing data is kept when limits are lowered.
admin.defaults_hint: Default quotas apply to users without overrides. Zero blocks new days or uploads; existing data is kept.
admin.error.protected: You cannot deactivate or delete yourself or the last active administrator.
admin.error.quota: Use nonnegative quotas, or leave blank for the site default. Day counts must be whole numbers; storage in M must represent whole bytes.
admin.error.settings: Choose a supported language and nonnegative limits. Counts must be whole numbers; storage in M must represent whole bytes. Keep-login duration must be 1–106751 days.
admin.error.confirm: Confirm permanent deletion before deleting a user.

password.forced: Please set a new password before continuing.
password.error.policy: The new password must be 8–32 characters.
password.error.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.error.unchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
password.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
setup.title: Set up PandaDays
setup.token_hint: Printed in the server logs at startup. Valid for 1 hour; restart the server to get a new one.
setup.timezone_hint: Detected from your browser. You can change the timezone here or later in Settings.
setup.error.token: The setup token is invalid or has expired. Restart the server to get a new one.
setup.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
setup.error.identity: Username and email are required and must not already be in use.
days.unsaved_hint: Changes are not saved until you submit this form. Your browser will ask for confirmation before leaving with unsaved changes.

attachments.create_hint: Optional. Files are uploaded when you create the day. After a validation error, select the files again.

attachments.error.limit: The upload exceeds the remaining storage allowance.
attachments.record_error: Microphone access or recording is not available.
attachments.upload_error: The recording could not be uploaded.
days.delete_confirm: Delete this day? This cannot be undone.
days.field.title: Title
days.field.time_hint: Leave empty for an all-day date.
days.field.tags_hint: If no tag is selected, Default is used.

days.field.comment_hint: Shown only on the card view.

days.error.tag: Please choose only your own tags.

groups.error.reserved: The Default cannot be renamed or deleted.
collections.title: Collections
collections.delete_hint: Deleting this collection moves its days to Default.
collections.delete_confirm: Delete this collection? Its days will be moved to Default.
tags.title: Tags

tags.delete_confirm: Delete this tag? It will be removed from its days.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.sensitive: Backups contain all users, media, password hashes, and session records. Store them securely. The site is temporarily unavailable while a backup is created and downloaded.
backup.retention: Retain up to %d ordinary backups. Zero disables retention.
backup.retain: Keep a copy on the server
backup.recovery: Pre-restore recovery snapshots are kept until you explicitly delete them and do not count toward retention.
backup.warning: Restoring replaces all site data and media and signs everyone out. A recovery snapshot is saved first. Sign in afterward using the restored credentials. Do not stop the server during restore.
backup.maintenance: PandaDays is temporarily unavailable for backup or restore. Please try again shortly.
backup.error.password: Password verification failed or is temporarily rate limited. Please try again later.
backup.error.upload: The backup upload or form could not be read. Please try again.
backup.error.archive: The backup could not be validated. Check the archive, schema version, and available disk space.
backup.error.failed: The backup operation failed. Check server logs and available disk space before trying again.
backup.error.retention: Set backup retention above zero in Site Settings before creating a retained backup.
